lb-b2cp.title: Make wiki prompt retrieval-oriented
lb-b2cp.description:
Goal: Revise the Trapperkeeper prime/session prompt so agents maintain toc.md and index.md for retrieval value, not just mechanical bookkeeping.
Context: User feedback from my2048 showed toc.md and index.md were only mildly useful because the prompt emphasizes consistency but not search-oriented entries. Existing prompt text lives in src/cmd/prime.rs; SPEC.md describes toc/index purpose; tests/merge.rs asserts prime output contains format guidance.
Requirements: Update the generated wiki instructions to say the wiki is a retrieval system, add an index quality bar focused on phrases future agents would search before editing code, require or strongly encourage page-level retrieval hooks with concepts/files/useful-when cues, and add a value threshold for wiki updates so agents record durable architecture, decisions, invariants, file ownership, and traps instead of noisy transcript notes. Keep current format invariants for one-line toc/index entries, sorted index, sorted toc sections, and log append behavior. Update tests and docs where they pin or describe the prompt.
Acceptance: trk prime output includes concrete guidance for search-oriented index entries, retrieval hooks, and durable-knowledge update thresholds; existing merge/prime tests pass or are updated to cover the new language; SPEC.md or equivalent docs reflect the intent that toc/index should reduce future code exploration.
Out of scope: Building automated indexing, changing wiki file formats, or modifying storage modes.
